# Self-review report

Reviewed pull request #392 at immutable head
`d757a1954ccae9435562a4d5bb036b4864f085b0` against `main` at
`0b828b5b8d0dac5507854b98ea1284edfc681de1`.

## Findings

1. **Fixed — wrapped connection failures bypassed the retry loop.**
   `_urlopen_transport` converted `URLError(ConnectionError(...))` into
   `ApiError`, so connection failures wrapped by `urllib` could not reach the
   new bounded retry handling. Commit
   `c4ea49e332278d297849ced622e034d8428a6493` preserves the underlying
   `ConnectionError` and adds focused regression coverage.

No additional correctness, security, maintainability, test-coverage, or
simplification findings remained after the second complete review.
